quests.title: Windtrace

dialogue.t: Welcome, adventurer. How have your travels been going thus far?
That's good. You're well on your way to becoming a truly amazing adventurer.
Ah, yes, if you're interested, you can go over to Gygax's and try the latest edition of Windtrace.

dialogue.sit: Does this have anything to do with the Adventurers' Guild?

dialogue.t: Well, Gygax has actually put up a commission for us to help him look for people to test Windtrace...
So I suppose you could call the two matters related from that perspective.
In any case, give it a go if you're willing. According to adventurers who have previously played it, it's actually quite fun...
Hey there, fancy trying your hand at Windtrace?

dialogue.sit: So, what's the situation with Windtrace?

dialogue.t: I'm glad you asked. Windtrace is a game that's all about Mondstadt's history!
I suppose you've heard of the aristocrats who once lived in Mondstadt City?
They were tyrants, and their rule was brutal. Words cannot do justice to the way that people suffered at their hands...
To fight back against their oppression, a group of brave citizens came together and formed an underground resistance.
These valiant rebels engaged in operations throughout the city, becoming a major thorn in the side of the aristocrats.
But the aristocrats retaliated, quickly training up their own team of henchmen to suppress the rebels.
And so, the rebels fought duel after duel with the aristocrats' lackeys all across Mondstadt.
Windtrace takes its inspiration from this thrilling chapter of Mondstadt's history! And it used to be quite popular, too...
Sadly, yes. Young people these days don't seem very interested in the game...
But I can't let Windtrace fade into obscurity. So, I tweaked the rules a little to make it easier to get into and more fun.
I also added a whole load of brand-new maps in. Hopefully, this will help to attract more people...
Heh. But don't take my word for it — try it out for yourself!

quests.description: Gygax from Mondstadt seems to be trying to drum up some interest in a certain game…
